<p id="mwCw">In <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mathematics" title="Mathematics" id="mwDA">mathematics</a>, the <b id="mwDQ">mice problem</b> is a continuous <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pursuit–evasion" title="Pursuit–evasion" id="mwDg">pursuit–evasion</a> problem in which a number of mice (or insects, dogs, missiles, etc.) are considered to be placed at the corners of a <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_polygon" title="Regular polygon" id="mwDw">regular polygon</a>. In the classic setup, each then begins to move towards its immediate neighbour (clockwise or anticlockwise). The goal is often to find out at what time the mice meet.</p>

<p id="mwEA">The most common version has the mice starting at the corners of a unit square, moving at unit speed. In this case they meet after a time of one unit, because the distance between two neighboring mice always decreases at a speed of one unit. <meta property="mw:PageProp/toc" id="mwHA" data-mw="{"autoGenerated":true}"></section><section data-mw-section-id="1" id="mwHQ" aria-labelledby="Path_of_the_mice"><div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Path_of_the_mice">Path of the mice</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/index.php?title=Mice_problem&action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section: Path of the mice"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>

<p id="mwHg">For all regular polygons, each mouse traces out a <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pursuit_curve" title="Pursuit curve" id="mwHw">pursuit curve</a> in the shape of a <a rel="mw:WikiLink" href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Logarithmic_spiral" title="Logarithmic spiral" id="mwIA">logarithmic spiral</a>. These curves meet in the center of the polygon.<sup about="#mwt17" class="mw-ref reference" id="cite_ref-3" rel="dc:references" typeof="mw:Extension/ref" data-mw="{"name":"ref","attrs":{},"body":{"id":"mw-reference-text-cite_note-3"}}"><a href="#cite_note-3" id="mwIQ"><span class="mw-reflink-text" id="mwIg"><span class="cite-bracket" id="mwIw">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket" id="mwJA">]</span></span></a></sup></p>
